goal: Verify that a user can successfully register as a Site Host and immediately create a new memo entry.
instructions: On the 'Create your account' page, enter 'alice' into the 'Username' field.
Click the 'Sign up' button to complete the registration.
Once on the dashboard, type 'Remember to review the project timeline tomorrow morning.' into the text area labeled 'Any thoughts...'.
Click the 'Save' button to publish the memo.
success_criteria: The user is successfully redirected from the registration page to the main dashboard view.
The newly created memo containing the text 'Remember to review the project timeline tomorrow morning.' is visible in the feed.
The memo entry displays a timestamp of 'now'.
The 'Save' button is no longer active or the input field is cleared after submission.
No error messages are displayed during the account creation or memo saving process.
